title: What If Every Visa Swipe Made a Beep?
description:
Visa handled 281.3 billion payments last year. Imagine each one beeped.

Sources:
- Visa: Fiscal fourth quarter and full-year 2026 results (PDF): https://s1.q4cdn.com/050606653/files/content_files/4Q26-Earnings-Release_vFINAL.pdf
- Wikipedia: Visa Inc.: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Visa_Inc.

Visa fiscal 2026 (year ended Sept 30 2026), earnings release: 281.3 billion processed transactions, up 9%; net revenue $45.9 billion. Wikipedia: Visa does not issue cards, extend credit or set consumer rates. Our math: 281.3 billion / 31.5 million seconds in a year = about 8,900 a second; one beep a second = about 8,900 years. Not financial advice.

#shorts #visa #whatif #howtheymakemoney

scenes.narration: Visa handled 281.3 billion payments last year. Imagine each one beeped.
Just one beep for every swipe.
Then do the math. About 8,900 beeps every second.
Now hear them one per second. Still 8,900 years.
But Visa doesn't lend you money. It earns fees for running the network. 45.9 billion dollars.
